root: Fighter startup applies AuraScaler and AuraIdentity, then HitResolver applies them again to BASE melee. Form overlays already carry resolved ownership.
affected: Confirmed damage, resolution-stage knockback scaling/element metadata and repeat identity features can differ; actual startup timing and live collision geometry already use the first resolved move. Direct throw and projectile paths have different construction; this experiment deliberately leaves them unchanged.
decision: Preserve historical BASE default; expose opt-in per-battle candidate for controlled comparison. No silent rewrite of216 BASE records. Candidate is not final approved balance.
candidate_owner: fighter metadata base_aura_single_pass_candidate; not saved or set by ordinary modes
